mapper.select: SELECT mn.*,pro.P_Name AS projectName, con.Con_Name AS contractName, com.C_Name AS constructionUnitName FROM Project_Acceptance_Settlement mn LEFT JOIN pre_project pro ON mn.project_id = pro.P_ID LEFT JOIN con_contract con ON mn.contract_id = con.Con_Id LEFT JOIN sys_company com ON mn.construction_unit = com.C_ID WHERE mn.id = #{id}
